subtitle: Master your favorite songs while understanding the theory behind them

overview.title: Beyond Just Tablature: Theory-Based Song Learning
overview.text: Learning songs is one of the most enjoyable aspects of playing guitar, but simply reading tablature only scratches the surface. Our approach teaches you to understand why songs work the way they do, connecting every riff, chord, and technique to fundamental music theory concepts. By analyzing songs through the lens of theory, you'll develop the skills to:
bulletItems: Understand why certain scales work over progressions
Learn songs faster by recognizing patterns
Write your own songs using proven formulas

steps.title: 1. Analysis Method
steps.description: Learn how to deconstruct tonal centers, identify the key, and convert chord progressions to Roman numerals.

steps.title: 2. Song Structure
steps.description: Master the functional architecture of verses, soaring choruses, pre-choruses, and dynamic bridges.

steps.title: 3. Chord Progressions
steps.description: Recognize standard harmonic movements (I-V-vi-IV, I-IV-V, ii-V-I) and voice leading across songs.

steps.title: 4. Why Songs Work
steps.description: Unlock the secret harmonic sauce (Mixolydian modal drive, line clichés, pedal points, Picardy thirds).

steps.title: 5. Song Analysis & Tabs
steps.description: Put theory into muscle memory with 128+ complete song breakdowns, standard notation, and audio playback.
